entries.name: Dick Gregory

expected.convicted: Arrested and jailed for illegal net fishing during a treaty-rights 'fish-in'
expected.sentence: Arrested in 1966 during a Nisqually-led 'fish-in' in Washington protesting restrictions that conflicted with treaty fishing rights; charged with illegal net fishing and undertook a prolonged fast while jailed.

updates.sentence: Initial detention for a Nisqually treaty-rights fish-in: arrested February 16, 1966 and released on bail February 17. The Civil Liberties Docket describes two days in jail, counting calendar dates. Sentenced January 12, 1967; the later 1968 sentence service was separate from this pretrial detention.

entries.rationale: Civil Liberties Docket entry604.10 supplies February16 arrest and January12 sentencing; Janet McCloud and R.C. contemporary Seattle Group account supplies February17 bail release. Elapsed date difference is one day; source two days is inclusive calendar counting. Separate 1968 confinement is not treated as continuous since1966.
